payload.title: DIP-L01: Verify trusted automatic capture in real coding hosts
payload.description:
Verification gap. QA baseline: DIP v0.3.2, 6 October 2026.

The v0.3.2 desktop trials validated CLI/MCP fallback, not trusted automatic prompt/plan capture. DIP hooks were awaiting user trust and UserPromptSubmit was unobserved. Claude has installed-command fixture coverage rather than a model-backed host trial.

Evidence and starting points: docs/desktop-qa.md, docs/compatibility.md.

This is unassigned contributor backlog, not implemented work. Preserve the existing license, DCO and local/offline defaults.
acceptance: Run bounded real Codex and Claude sessions with hooks loaded and explicitly trusted; record host/OS/version and distinguish UI prompts from app-tool-created turns.
Verify injected task identity, durable prompt and structured-plan events, future backlog, resume/compaction and handoff behavior against disk state.
Disabled, untrusted or unsupported hooks remain visibly unconfirmed and preserve the explicit fallback; never bypass host trust.
Publish redacted reproduction steps, failures and actual coverage; do not infer host delivery from installed configuration.
